title: Extremal product laws
task: Prove an appropriate reduction from densities in [0,1] of mass1 to product indicators or mixtures, then attack the resulting geometric sublevel-set inequality. Do not assume a single interval or a centered uniform law is extremal.
method: alternative proof mechanisms and complete-argument integration
acceptance: A proved target-level implication, explicit rigorous counterexample, or quantitatively stated supporting lemma whose remaining connection to the full target is explicit.
